name: Ship Schedules
summary: A scroll records ships sailing between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay, with marks beside some voyages. It belongs in the hands of an authority at Steamwheedle Port.

sections.title: The Scroll
sections.body: The scroll lists the shipments that sail between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay, those already made and those to come, along with the ships' names. Some journeys are marked with a large X, and others carry notes about plunder to be had or a hard fight. It is meant for someone in authority at Steamwheedle Port.

sections.title: The Port's Reaction
sections.body: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle finds the dates and times on the schedule accurate, and fears what a pirate captain could do with it. On hearing that you took it from a pirate, Bilgewhizzle calls that disturbing news, thanks you, and is glad the pirate is dead.

faq.q: What is written on the schedule?
aliases: what does the ship schedule say
faq.answer: Ship names and the timings of voyages between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay, past and future, with large X marks beside some journeys and notes about plunder or a hard fight beside others.

faq.q: Who needs to see this document?
aliases: who do i give the schedule to
faq.answer: Someone in authority at Steamwheedle Port. Security Chief Bilgewhizzle is the one who takes it.
